Affects Figure 1 only; no target.

Code observation (confirmed by run, judged a design inconsistency rather than a bug): cell 8 complete-set Africa-based counts use each author's first row (notebook JSON line 318, df2 = ...drop_duplicates(keep='first')), while the top-5% counts use the mode-based node attribute. With the mode-based value the 2021 complete-set count would be 120 instead of 117, 2010 79 instead of 77 (outputs/code_checks.json). Top-5% counts are the same either way (2021: 2 vs 2; 2010: 6 vs 6). Not a target value; T2's comparison direction is unaffected.
